title: ULTRON Skills Manifest Entry
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for a single entry in skills.manifest.yaml. The manifest is an array of these entries.

name.description: Unique skill identifier (e.g. 'superpowers:systematic-debugging' or 'windows-admin'). No control chars (Codex S4 M3).

triggers.description: Keywords/phrases that trigger this skill in the dispatcher. No control chars/newlines (Codex S4 M3).

tags.description: Semantic tags for filtering and categorization. No control chars (Codex S4 M3).

cost_tier.description: Estimated token cost tier for invoking this skill

dispatcher_priority.description: Routing priority (1=highest, 5=lowest). Lower number wins on tie.

deprecated.description: Whether this skill is deprecated (hidden from active routing by default)

replaces.description: List of skill names this entry supersedes

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 date of last routing telemetry hit

last_synced.description: ISO 8601 date of last manifest sync that touched this entry

description.description: Human-readable one-line description synthesized from SKILL.md or skill name

kind.description: Skill kind from SKILL.md frontmatter (skill, persona, meta, hookify, mcp)

tier.description: Skill tier from SKILL.md frontmatter (L1, L2, L3)

security_status.description: F05 fix: security verdict status when registry sync surfaces a quarantine decision. Distinct from `deprecated` (which can be benign). Optional.

security_status_reason.description: Human-readable reason / rule_id that triggered the security_status (e.g. 'security_quarantine_pending:PI002'). Optional.
